mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_page_view_log ( agent_code, visitor_id, ip_address, user_agent, referer, device_type, visit_time ) VALUES ( #{agentCode}, #{visitorId}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{referer}, #{deviceType}, IFNULL(#{visitTime}, NOW()) )

INSERT INTO t_page_view_log ( agent_code, visitor_id, ip_address, user_agent, referer, device_type, visit_time ) VALUES
( #{log.agentCode}, #{log.visitorId}, #{log.ipAddress}, #{log.userAgent}, #{log.referer}, #{log.deviceType}, IFNULL(#{log.visitTime}, NOW()) )

INSERT INTO t_page_view_statistics ( agent_code, view_date, view_count, visitor_count, ip_count ) SELECT #{agentCode} as agent_code, #{viewDate} as view_date, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as view_count, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as visitor_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) as ip_count FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND DATE(visit_time) = #{viewDate} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = VALUES(view_count), visitor_count = VALUES(visitor_count), ip_count = VALUES(ip_count), update_time = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE t_page_view_statistics SET view_count = #{viewCount}, visitor_count = #{visitorCount}, ip_count = #{ipCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND view_date = #{viewDate}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) as totalViews, COALESCE(SUM(visitor_count), 0) as totalVisitors, COALESCE(SUM(ip_count), 0) as totalIps, COALESCE(AVG(view_count), 0) as avgDailyViews, COALESCE(MAX(view_count), 0) as maxDailyViews, COALESCE(MIN(view_date), '') as firstDate, COALESCE(MAX(view_date), '') as lastDate, COUNT(*) as activeDays FROM t_page_view_statistics WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND view_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT agent_code as agentCode, view_count as viewCount, visitor_count as visitorCount, ip_count as ipCount FROM t_page_view_statistics WHERE view_date = #{viewDate} ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CASE WHEN referer IS NULL OR referer = '' THEN '直接访问' ELSE referer END as referer, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as uniqueVisitors FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND DATE(visit_time) = #{viewDate} GROUP BY referer ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COALESCE(device_type, 'Unknown') as deviceType, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as uniqueVisitors, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND DATE(visit_time) = #{viewDate}), 2) as percentage FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND DATE(visit_time) = #{viewDate} GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT HOUR(visit_time) as hour, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as uniqueVisitors FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND DATE(visit_time) = #{viewDate} GROUP BY HOUR(visit_time) ORDER BY hour

SELECT ip_address as ipAddress, COUNT(*) as viewCount, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as uniqueVisitors, MIN(visit_time) as firstVisit, MAX(visit_time) as lastVisit FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND DATE(visit_time) = #{viewDate} GROUP BY ip_address ORDER BY viewCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as totalViews, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) as uniqueVisitors, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) as uniqueIps, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN device_type = 'Mobile' THEN visitor_id END) as mobileViews, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN device_type = 'PC' THEN visitor_id END) as pcViews, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN device_type = 'Tablet' THEN visitor_id END) as tabletViews, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN referer IS NULL OR referer = '' THEN visitor_id END) as directViews, MAX(visit_time) as lastVisitTime FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND DATE(visit_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT MIN(visit_time) FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode}
SELECT MAX(visit_time) FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND DATE(visit_time) = #{viewDate}) as logCount, (SELECT COALESCE(view_count, 0) FROM t_page_view_statistics WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND view_date = #{viewDate}) as statsCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_page_view_log WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND DATE(visit_time) = #{viewDate}) = (SELECT COALESCE(view_count, 0) FROM t_page_view_statistics WHERE agent_code = #{agentCode} AND view_date = #{viewDate}) as isConsistent
